notes = """# NOTES (keep updated)
## Facts about start model
- reserved dims RES=[83,88,222,254,444,495,506,601]; hidden[2]+ reserved=0 (layer1 out LN gamma=beta=0). Layers 2-10 cut reads/writes of RES; gamma=1,beta=0 for RES in all LNs of layers 2-11.

- pooler rows0-7 ridge, classifier selects pooled dims 0-7.
## Plan
- Final structure = PREFIX layers [0..K-1] + layer 11 (pool) with FFN narrowed to m (weights-only unit selection).
- Pass 1 = READ edited model with all 12 layers, m=1024, carry PROBES (V bias const 0.1 in dim d_j; layers 2..8 -> dims 0..6, dim7 ref) on 1024 stratified ids (128/class).

  Fit ridge on [c (non-res dims), kappa_j*xbar_j (mean_hidden[j])] CV by K; choose K, write carry V rows, pooler rows, bias.
- Pass 2 = READ final model on 472 heldout + 128 train ids, outputs logits -> heldout accuracy + fidelity check.
"""
